## Definition of Done

- [ ] `scripts/check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] Docs touched by the change are updated
- [ ] Handoff written in `docs/handoffs/` and `docs/progress.md` updated
- [ ] Reviewed by QA, or by a second agent / the human (say who)
- [ ] New ADR in `docs/decisions/` if an architecture decision was made
